messages.content: Can you find all the Drama and Comedy movies that Leonardo DiCaprio starred in 2010 and 2012 respectively by searching the database?

function.name: imdb_find_movies_by_actor
function.description: Searches the database to find all movies by a specific actor within a certain year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: The specific year to search in.

category.description: The category of the film (e.g. Drama, Comedy, etc). This parameter is optional.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to find all the Drama and Comedy movies that Leonardo DiCaprio starred in 2010 and 2012 respectively. They want to search the database. We have a function imdb_find_movies_by_actor that searches the database to find all movies by a specific actor within a certain year. It has parameters: actor_name (string), year (number), category? (string, default "Drama"). So we can call this function twice: once for 2010 with category "Drama" and once for 2012 with category "Comedy". But the user says "all the Drama and Comedy movies that Leonardo DiCaprio starred in 2010 and 2012 respectively". That implies two separate queries: one for 2010 drama movies, one for 2012 comedy movies. So we need to call the function twice.

We should use the function calls. We'll do:

1. imdb_find_movies_by_actor({"actor_name":"Leonardo DiCaprio","year":2010,"category":"Drama"})
2. imdb_find_movies_by_actor({"actor_name":"Leonardo DiCaprio","year":2012,"category":"Comedy"})
